display.purpose: Hero headlines only — maximum impact, tight leading.

headline.purpose: Section headlines — strong presence with comfortable reading.

body.purpose: Primary reading text — optimal readability at 65ch max width.

label.purpose: Navigation, buttons, chips, and UI labels — uppercase for section markers.

shadows.name: blue-glow
shadows.purpose: Interactive hover states, CTAs, and emphasis.

shadows.name: intense-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover and high-emphasis elements.

motion.name: ease-default
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions — smooth deceleration.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Quick feedback — hover states, focus rings.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Standard transitions — color changes, opacity shifts.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Deliberate transitions — card elevations, layout changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button — vibrant blue with glow hover effect.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563EB; color: #fff; padding: 16px 32px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; border-radius: 16px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); box-shadow: 0 0 60px -12px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3B82F6; box-shadow: 0 0 100px -24px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost button for secondary actions — transparent with blue text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #2563EB; padding: 16px 32px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; border-radius: 16px; border: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: all 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #EFF6FF; border-color: #BFDBFE; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Container for product showcases — white surface with glow hover.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; transition: all 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #BFDBFE; box-shadow: 0 0 60px -12px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); }

components.name: Tech Chip
components.description: Technology stack indicator — pill-shaped badge with blue accent.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #EFF6FF; color: #2563EB; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #DBEAFE; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Top navigation link — gray text with blue hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #4b5563; text-decoration: none; transition: color 300ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #2563EB; }

narrative.overview:
A spacious, confident design system that lets the work speak. The aesthetic is modern and restrained — generous whitespace, clear hierarchy, and purposeful motion create an environment where technical capability is demonstrated, not declared. Every element earns its place through function, not decoration.

The system balances professionalism with approachability. Navy anchors authority and depth, while vibrant blue provides energy and focus. The result is a visual language that feels established and trustworthy without being stiff or corporate.
keyCharacteristics: Spacious layout with generous section breathing room
Purposeful motion that guides without distracting

rules.name: The Blue Accent Rule
rules.body: Vibrant blue is used sparingly — primarily on CTAs, links, and interactive elements. Its rarity creates focus; its absence elsewhere creates calm.

rules.name: The Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Never use display weight below display size. Never use body weight above headline size. The hierarchy is sacred.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Elements are flat at rest. Shadows appear on hover, focus, or elevation change — never as static decoration.

dos: Do use generous whitespace — let content breathe and create hierarchy through spacing
Do maintain the blue accent sparingly — its rarity creates focus
Do use structural shadows for elevation, not decoration
Do keep typography confident — strong weights, clear hierarchy
Do respect the section rhythm — 8rem between major sections
donts: Don't add shadows to static elements — they appear on interaction only
Don't use blue as a background color — it's reserved for text, borders, and accents
Don't break the typography hierarchy — never use display weight below display size
Don't add decorative elements that don't serve function
Don't reduce section spacing below 6rem — the breathing room is intentional
